attempt_history.llm_sketch:
workflow_id: progress_photo_upload
steps:
  - id: step_receive_upload
    op: fetch_api
    params:
      endpoint: "/api/photos/upload"
      method: "POST"
    output: raw_upload

  - id: step_authenticate
    op: authenticate_user
    params:
      role: "user"
    output: auth_result

  - id: step_validate_schema
    op: validate_schema
    params:
      input: raw_upload
      schema:
        type: object
        required:
          - image
          - date
          - user_id
        properties:
          image:
            type: binary
            max_size_mb: 10
            allowed_formats:
              - "image/jpeg"
              - "image/png"
              - "image/webp"
          date:
            type: string
            format: date
          notes:
            type: string
            max_length: 500
          user_id:
            type: string
    output: validated_upload

  - id: step_extract_image
    op: extract_field
    params:
      input: validated_upload
      field: "image"
    output: raw_image

  - id: step_encrypt_image
    op: encrypt_field
    params:
      input: raw_image
      algorithm: "AES-256"
    output: encrypted_image

  - id: step_transform_record
    op: transform_json
    params:
      input: validated_upload
      mapping:
        user_id: "$.user_id"
        photo_date: "$.date"
        notes: "$.notes"
        encrypted_image: encrypted_image
        visibility: "private"
        uploaded_at: "@now"
    output: photo_record

  - id: step_write_photo
    op: write_database
    params:
      input: photo_record
      table: user_progress_photos
      privacy: "private"
    output: write_result

  - id: step_audit_log
    op: log_audit
    params:
      input: photo_record
      action: "progress_photo_uploaded"
      details:
        user_id: "$.user_id"
        photo_date: "$.photo_date"
        visibility: "private"
    output: audit_result

  - id: step_notify_user
    op: notify_user
    params:
      input: photo_record
      channel: "in_app"
      message: "Your progress photo has been uploaded successfully."
    output: notification_result

  - id: step_handle_error
    op: handle_error
    params:
      on_error: "step_terminate_failure"
      scope:
        - step_receive_upload
        - step_validate_schema
        - step_write_photo

  - id: step_terminate_success
    op: terminate_workflow
    params:
      status: "success"
      message: "Progress photo uploaded and stored securely."

  - id: step_terminate_failure
    op: terminate_workflow
    params:
      status: "failure"
      message: "Progress photo upload failed. Please try again."
